item.description:
Bouncebin 1.1.1

  • The 3D view is smoother. It was redrawing constantly, even sitting perfectly still, which showed up as stutter. It now draws only when something actually moves.
  • Remove cover and Remove back are in the 3D view, where only the Change buttons were. Taking one off puts the generated card back — the title in type on the front, the running order on the back.
  • Choosing or removing a cover no longer drops you back to the LP sleeve when you were looking at the CD case.
  • The shrink wrap sits on the case instead of hovering slightly above it. It was noticeable on the CD, whose case is much deeper than a sleeve.
